# Module `lune_ui_core::json`

[API reference](../INDEX.md) / parent [`lune_ui_core`](index.md)

A bounded JSON reader. Bytes in, a value tree or a structured error out; no file system, no
clock, no third-party code. It reads files a user can edit (themes, locale tables), so every path
from bytes to a value is closed: any byte slice returns `Ok(Value)` or `Err(JsonError)`, never a
panic and never a partial tree.

Bounds (constants below, in one place):
- the input is refused above [`MAX_INPUT`](json.md#constant.MAX_INPUT) before any parsing, and is validated as UTF-8 once;
- nesting is at most [`MAX_DEPTH`](json.md#constant.MAX_DEPTH) containers deep, so the recursion is at most that many frames
  plus a constant;
- a decoded string is at most [`MAX_STRING`](json.md#constant.MAX_STRING) bytes, a key at most [`MAX_KEY`](json.md#constant.MAX_KEY);
- an object or array holds at most [`MAX_MEMBERS`](json.md#constant.MAX_MEMBERS) members, the whole tree at most
  [`MAX_VALUES`](json.md#constant.MAX_VALUES) values;
- work is linear in the input (duplicate-key checks are `n log n`), memory bounded by the input
  and the limits above.

The grammar is RFC 8259's. A leading UTF-8 byte-order mark is skipped (offsets still count it).
Duplicate keys in one object are an error. A number is a finite `f64`; an integer literal whose
magnitude is above 2^53 is an inexact value ([`Number::is_exact_int`](json.md#method.Number.is_exact_int) is false and
[`Value::as_int`](json.md#method.Value.as_int) refuses it); anything that overflows to infinity is an error, underflow to zero
is a value.

Errors are structured, not sentences: the app writes the text. `offset` is a byte offset into the
input as given; `line` and `column` (1-based, columns in characters) are computed once, on error.
The typed readers on [`Value`](json.md#enum.Value) report no position (`offset`, `line` and `column` are all 0).

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/json.rs:1`

## Enums

<a id="enum.JsonErrorKind"></a>
### Enum `JsonErrorKind`

```rust
pub enum JsonErrorKind {
    TooLarge,
    TooDeep,
    StringTooLong,
    KeyTooLong,
    TooManyMembers,
    TooManyValues,
    InvalidUtf8,
    Syntax(&'static str),
    InvalidEscape,
    TrailingData,
    DuplicateKey(String),
    NumberOutOfRange,
    WrongType,
    Missing(String),
}
```

What went wrong. Reader errors carry a position; the last two come from the typed readers.

Source: `crates/lune-ui-core/src/json.rs:47`

**Variants**

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.TooLarge"></a>`TooLarge`

  The input is longer than [`MAX_INPUT`](json.md#constant.MAX_INPUT).

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.TooDeep"></a>`TooDeep`

  More than [`MAX_DEPTH`](json.md#constant.MAX_DEPTH) containers deep.

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.StringTooLong"></a>`StringTooLong`

  A decoded string longer than [`MAX_STRING`](json.md#constant.MAX_STRING) bytes (offset: its opening quote).

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.KeyTooLong"></a>`KeyTooLong`

  A decoded key longer than [`MAX_KEY`](json.md#constant.MAX_KEY) bytes (offset: its opening quote).

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.TooManyMembers"></a>`TooManyMembers`

  A container with more than [`MAX_MEMBERS`](json.md#constant.MAX_MEMBERS) members (offset: the first one over).

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.TooManyValues"></a>`TooManyValues`

  More than [`MAX_VALUES`](json.md#constant.MAX_VALUES) values in the tree (offset: the first one over).

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.InvalidUtf8"></a>`InvalidUtf8`

  The bytes are not UTF-8 (offset: the first bad byte).

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.Syntax"></a>`Syntax(&'static str)`

  The text breaks the grammar; the reason is a fixed phrase.

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.InvalidEscape"></a>`InvalidEscape`

  A bad escape in a string, including a lone surrogate (offset: its backslash).

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.TrailingData"></a>`TrailingData`

  Something follows the value.

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.DuplicateKey"></a>`DuplicateKey(String)`

  An object names a key twice (offset: the second one). The key is at most [`MAX_KEY`](json.md#constant.MAX_KEY) bytes.

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.NumberOutOfRange"></a>`NumberOutOfRange`

  A number that overflows `f64` (offset: its first character).

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.WrongType"></a>`WrongType`

  A typed reader found another kind of value.

- <a id="variant.JsonErrorKind.Missing"></a>`Missing(String)`

  A typed reader found no member of this name.

## Constants

<a id="constant.MAX_DEPTH"></a>
### Constant `MAX_DEPTH`

```rust
pub const MAX_DEPTH: usize = 16;
```

Deepest nesting of arrays and objects. Scalars at the top are depth 0; 16 nested arrays are
allowed, 17 are [`JsonErrorKind::TooDeep`](json.md#variant.JsonErrorKind.TooDeep).
